publications.title: Exploring Potential COX-2 Inhibitors of Ibuprofen Derivatives: Integrating DFT, Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics Simulations, ADMET with FEL and MMPBSA Analyses
authors: et al. — VERIFY full list on the DOI page
publications.summary: Designed 14 ibuprofen derivatives by replacing the carboxylic acid group (linked to ibuprofen's side effects) with acyl and amide groups. DFT, docking, MD simulations and ADMET screening showed most derivatives bind COX-2 more strongly than ibuprofen, with compound I7 standing out.
highlights: Ibuprofen: -7.3 kcal/mol vs best derivatives I7: -9.0 and I9: -8.8 kcal/mol
I7–COX-2 complex binding free energy (MMPBSA): -78.02 kJ/mol
Favourable predicted drug-likeness and lower toxicity

publications.title: Toward efficient and sustainable perovskite solar cells: a combined first-principles and device simulation study of K2LiGa(Cl/Br)6 for photovoltaic performance optimization
publications.titleHtml: Toward efficient and sustainable perovskite solar cells: a combined first-principles and device simulation study of K<sub>2</sub>LiGa(Cl/Br)<sub>6</sub> for photovoltaic performance optimization
publications.summary: Evaluated two lead-free double halide perovskites as solar-cell absorbers by pairing first-principles (DFT) calculations with SCAPS-1D device simulation to optimise photovoltaic performance.

publications.title: Synthesis, antimicrobial evaluation, and integrated DFT, molecular docking, and dynamics simulation studies of the novel pentanoylated methyl α-D-mannopyranoside derivatives
publications.summary: Synthesised new sugar-based (mannopyranoside) derivatives, tested them against bacterial and fungal pathogens, and used DFT, docking and dynamics simulations to explain their activity.
